topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? My essay, the one I slaved over for weeks? It's out there, being seen by people who might get inspired or learn something from it. I mean, I was just trying to tell my story, share why this school means everything to me, and now it's like I'm part of something bigger. It’s like, wow, the hard work, all the nights I couldn’t sleep, wondering if it was good enough. And now, here it is, proving that sometimes, just being you is enough. I can't wait to show you the article when it’s all ready. This is just the best!
